def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    prices = [120, 123, 121, 125, 130]
    volumes = [1500, 1600, 1550, 1700, 1800]

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    vpt = [0]
    for i in range(1, len(prices)):
        price_change = (prices[i] - prices[i - 1]) / prices[i - 1]
        vpt.append(vpt[i - 1] + price_change * volumes[i])

    answer = round(vpt[-1], 2)

    # return answer
    return answer
